description: This file declares functions related to CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) calculations, specifically CRC16-A and CRC16-B, used in the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes a utility header and provides function prototypes for computing CRCs over byte vectors.

methods.name: WithCrc16A
methods.description: Calculates CRC16-A checksum for the given data vector.

methods.name: WithCrc16B
methods.description: Calculates CRC16-B checksum for the given data vector.
